completion: Every required journey passes on current source; native and web release artifacts and comparative evidence are available.

Release WASM is 14352282 bytes, SHA256 cd4fc5f17c9e032814d48ce0127e9ffbf19dbaa54830d065fe4ee5e407f44b32. This proves the protocol and encrypted checkpoint restoration, not rendered UI or real browser-process/IndexedDB durability.
